'''Fitsay''' was the principal [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. The city had a [[Cantina/Legends|inn]] for pilgrims, houses for the citizens and [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] and marketplaces where the local [[Sedrian]]s sold goods and wares. The seat of government was the [[High Priest House]], connected to it was the [[House of War]], the [[Audience Hall]] and the [[Priest House]]. The [[Great Shell Dome]] was the structure where the [[Golden Sun]] was held and the Sacred Pews, large benches that overlooked the Great Shell Dome where Sedrians from every region of the planet would sit and watch the wonders of the Golden Sun.

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Karak]] the power hungry leader of the [[Karak's renegades|Sedrian renegades]] struck a deal with the Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Aban]] to hand over the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] diplomat [[Mors Odrion]] and half of the [[Golden Sun]] in exchange for Imperial weapons for the renegades to subjugate the [[City/Legends|City]] and for Karak to take control of the [[sun caves]], the dwelling of the Golden Sun. Karak and Aban's plot to harness the power of the golden sun was impeded by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] sent to recover Odrion.<ref name="BGS" />

The Rebels had showed Karak's daughter, [[Fala (Sedrian)|Fala]], her father's lies as they showed her a hologram of Karak and Aban, proving he simply wanted the power for himself. Fala, shattered over the discovery of her father's dealings sent a hundred Renegade troops to assist in defending Fitsay and the Golden Sun from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces leading to the [[Sedri civil war]]. After fighting an [[Aquatic Terrain Armored Transport|AT-AT swimmer]] and [[Aquatic assault stormtrooper|Seatroopers]] the Rebels eventually defeated a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] powered Karak and allowed the Golden Sun's power to be shared with all Sedrians, dissipating the coral reef's immense power.<ref name="BGS" />
